<style>
/* ─────────── 사이트루미 편집기 ─────────── */
:root {
  --ed-ink: #111827; --ed-sub: #6B7280; --ed-faint: #9CA3AF; --ed-line: #E5E7EB; --ed-bg: #F5F6F8; --ed-card: #FFFFFF;
  --ed-key: #2563EB; --ed-key-soft: #EEF3FF; --ed-red: #DC2626; --ed-green: #16A34A; --ed-r: 12px;
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; background: var(--ed-bg); color: var(--ed-ink); font-family: 'Pretendard Variable', Pretendard, -apple-system, 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
button, input, select, textarea { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
button { cursor: pointer; }
a { color: var(--ed-key); }
.ed-boot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 100vh; color: var(--ed-sub); }
.ed-hide { display: none !important; }

/* 공통 입력 */
.ed-field { display: block; margin: 0 0 14px; }
.ed-label { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #374151; }
.ed-label small { font-weight: 400; color: var(--ed-faint); }
.ed-input, .ed-select, .ed-textarea { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 46px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--ed-line); border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; font-size: 16px; outline: none; transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; }
.ed-textarea { min-height: 92px; resize: none; overflow: hidden; line-height: 1.6; field-sizing: content; }   /* 쓰는 만큼 높이가 늘어남 */
.ed-input:focus, .ed-select:focus, .ed-textarea:focus { border-color: var(--ed-key); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, .14); }
.ed-input::placeholder, .ed-textarea::placeholder { color: #B0B6BF; }
.ed-help { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ed-sub); }
.ed-row2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }
.ed-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--ed-line); border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }
.ed-btn:hover { border-color: #C9CED6; }
.ed-btn.is-main { background: var(--ed-key); border-color: var(--ed-key); color: #fff; }
.ed-btn.is-main:hover { filter: brightness(.95); }
.ed-btn.is-dark { background: var(--ed-ink); border-color: var(--ed-ink); color: #fff; }
.ed-btn.is-danger { color: var(--ed-red); }
.ed-btn.is-small { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 13.5px; border-radius: 8px; }
.ed-btn.is-block { width: 100%; }
.ed-btn[disabled] { opacity: .5; cursor: default; }
.ed-link { padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--ed-key); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }
.ed-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.ed-chip { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--ed-line); border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; font-size: 14px; }
.ed-chip.is-on { border-color: var(--ed-key); background: var(--ed-key-soft); color: var(--ed-key); font-weight: 700; }
.ed-seg { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.ed-seg button { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--ed-line); border-radius: 9px; background: #fff; font-size: 13.5px; }
.ed-seg button.is-on { border-color: var(--ed-ink); background: var(--ed-ink); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; }
.ed-switch { position: relative; flex: 0 0 auto; width: 44px; height: 26px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #D1D5DB; transition: background .15s; }
.ed-switch::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.2); transition: transform .15s; }
.ed-switch.is-on { background: var(--ed-key); }
.ed-switch.is-on::after { transform: translateX(18px); }
.ed-note { padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--ed-key-soft); color: #1E3A8A; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.6; }
.ed-note.is-warn { background: #FEF3C7; color: #92400E; }
.ed-h2 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
.ed-h3 { margin: 22px 0 10px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--ed-sub); }
.ed-sub { margin: 0 0 18px; color: var(--ed-sub); font-size: 14px; }
.ed-card { padding: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--ed-line); border-radius: var(--ed-r); background: var(--ed-card); }
.ed-toast { position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 24px; z-index: 100; max-width: 92vw; padding: 12px 18px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(17, 24, 39, .94); color: #fff; font-size: 14px; transform: translateX(-50%); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.2); }
.ed-busy { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 90; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 24px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.82); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); }
.ed-busy-box { max-width: 360px; text-align: center; }
.ed-spin { width: 36px; height: 36px; margin: 0 auto 14px; border: 3px solid var(--ed-line); border-top-color: var(--ed-key); border-radius: 50%; animation: edspin .8s linear infinite; }
@keyframes edspin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

/* 로그인 */
.ed-auth { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 100vh; padding: 24px 16px; }
.ed-auth-box { width: 100%; max-width: 400px; }
.ed-logo { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 26px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; }
.ed-logo span { color: var(--ed-key); }
.ed-err { margin: 0 0 12px; color: var(--ed-red); font-size: 14px; }

/* 처음 세팅 마법사 */
.ed-wiz { min-height: 100vh; }
.ed-wiz-top { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 5; padding: 14px 16px 0; background: var(--ed-bg); }
.ed-wiz-progress { height: 4px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--ed-line); overflow: hidden; }
.ed-wiz-progress i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--ed-key); transition: width .25s; }
.ed-wiz-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ed-sub); }
.ed-wiz-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 20px; max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 18px 16px 120px; }
.ed-wiz-grid.has-preview { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
.ed-wiz-body { max-width: 560px; width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; }
.ed-wiz-nav { position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 6; display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 16px calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); border-top: 1px solid var(--ed-line); background: rgba(255,255,255,.96); }
.ed-wiz-nav .ed-btn { flex: 1; min-height: 52px; font-size: 16px; }
.ed-wiz-nav .ed-btn.is-main { flex: 2; }
.ed-ind-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(120px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; margin-top: 12px; }
.ed-ind { min-height: 52px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--ed-line); border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; font-size: 14.5px; text-align: center; }
.ed-ind.is-on { border-color: var(--ed-key); background: var(--ed-key-soft); color: var(--ed-key); font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(37,99,235,.15); }
.ed-hours-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 40px 1fr 70px; gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.ed-hours-row b { font-size: 14px; text-align: center; }
.ed-list-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 40px; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.ed-icon-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--ed-line); border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: var(--ed-sub); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1; }
.ed-icon-btn:hover { color: var(--ed-ink); }
.ed-icon-btn[disabled] { opacity: .35; }
.ed-contact-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ed-line); }
.ed-contact-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.ed-contact-row .ed-input { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.ed-check { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; }
.ed-check input { width: 20px; height: 20px; accent-color: var(--ed-key); }
.ed-radio { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ed-sub); }
.ed-radio input { accent-color: var(--ed-key); }

/* 스타일 고르기 카드 */
.ed-pick-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.ed-pick { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 6px; min-height: 96px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--ed-line); border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; text-align: left; }
.ed-pick.is-on { border-color: var(--ed-key); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(37,99,235,.2); }
.ed-pick b { font-size: 14.5px; }
.ed-pick small { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--ed-sub); }
.ed-pick .ed-badge { position: absolute; top: 10px; right: 10px; }
.ed-swatch { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
.ed-swatch i { width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 5px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.06); }
.ed-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ed-key-soft); color: var(--ed-key); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
.ed-badge.is-gray { background: #F3F4F6; color: var(--ed-sub); }
.ed-colors { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.ed-color { width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 2px solid #fff; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--ed-line); }
.ed-color.is-on { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ed-ink); }
.ed-color-auto { width: auto; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; font-size: 13px; }
input[type="color"].ed-color { padding: 0; overflow: hidden; }

/* 편집 화면 */
.ed-top { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ed-line); background: rgba(255,255,255,.96); }
.ed-top-title { flex: 1; min-width: 0; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.ed-top-title small { margin-left: 6px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ed-sub); }
.ed-dirty { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; margin-right: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #F59E0B; vertical-align: 1px; }
.ed-tabs { position: sticky; top: 56px; z-index: 19; display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; overflow-x: auto; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ed-line); background: #fff; scrollbar-width: none; }
.ed-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.ed-tab { flex: 0 0 auto; min-height: 38px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: var(--ed-sub); font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 600; }
.ed-tab.is-on { background: var(--ed-ink); color: #fff; }
.ed-main { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
.ed-panel { padding: 18px 16px 120px; }
.ed-preview { display: none; }
.ed-fab { position: fixed; right: 16px; bottom: calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); z-index: 30; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ed-ink); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(17,24,39,.3); }
.ed-preview.is-open { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 40; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--ed-bg); }
.ed-pv-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ed-line); background: #fff; }
.ed-pv-bar .ed-select { flex: 1; min-height: 38px; padding: 6px 10px; font-size: 14px; }
.ed-pv-stage { position: relative; flex: 1; overflow: auto; display: flex; justify-content: center; padding: 16px; }
.ed-pv-frame { width: 390px; max-width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 640px; border: 0; border-radius: 22px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.06), 0 12px 32px rgba(15,23,42,.12); }
.ed-pv-stage.is-pc { align-items: flex-start; padding: 16px; overflow: hidden; }
.ed-pv-stage.is-pc .ed-pv-frame { width: 1280px; max-width: none; height: 1600px; border-radius: 10px; transform-origin: top left; position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 16px; }
.ed-pv-stage.is-tb .ed-pv-frame { width: 820px; border-radius: 18px; }

/* 목록 (섹션 · 블록) */
.ed-pages { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin: 0 0 14px; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 4px; }
.ed-pages button { flex: 0 0 auto; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--ed-line); border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; font-size: 13.5px; }
.ed-pages button.is-on { border-color: var(--ed-key); background: var(--ed-key-soft); color: var(--ed-key); font-weight: 700; }
.ed-pages button.is-hidden { color: var(--ed-faint); text-decoration: line-through; }
.ed-items { display: grid; gap: 8px; }
.ed-item { border: 1px solid var(--ed-line); border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; }
.ed-item.is-off .ed-item-name { color: var(--ed-faint); }
.ed-item.is-open { border-color: #C7D2FE; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37,99,235,.08); }
.ed-item-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 10px 8px 12px; }
.ed-item-move { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.ed-item-move button { width: 26px; height: 20px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: #F3F4F6; color: var(--ed-sub); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1; }
.ed-item-move button[disabled] { opacity: .3; }
.ed-item-name { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 6px 0; border: 0; background: none; text-align: left; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; }
.ed-item-name small { display: block; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--ed-faint); }
.ed-item-body { padding: 4px 14px 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--ed-line); }
.ed-opts { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 14px 0 0; padding: 14px; border-radius: 10px; background: #F9FAFB; }
.ed-opts .ed-label { margin-bottom: 4px; }
.ed-item-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-top: 14px; }
.ed-sublist { display: grid; gap: 10px; }
.ed-sub-item { position: relative; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--ed-line); border-radius: 10px; background: #FCFCFD; }
.ed-sub-item .ed-field:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.ed-sub-tools { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 6px; margin: -2px 0 8px; }
.ed-sub-tools .ed-icon-btn { width: 32px; min-height: 30px; font-size: 13px; }
.ed-add { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; border: 1.5px dashed #CBD5E1; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--ed-sub); font-weight: 600; }
.ed-add:hover { border-color: var(--ed-key); color: var(--ed-key); }
.ed-sheet { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 60; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center; background: rgba(17,24,39,.4); }
.ed-sheet-box { width: 100%; max-width: 560px; max-height: 80vh; overflow: auto; padding: 20px 16px calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0; background: #fff; }
.ed-sheet-list { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin-top: 12px; }
.ed-sheet-list button { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 2px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--ed-line); border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; text-align: left; }
.ed-sheet-list small { color: var(--ed-sub); font-size: 12.5px; }
.ed-photo { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 56px 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: center; }
.ed-photo-thumb { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 10px; background: #F3F4F6 center / cover no-repeat; border: 1px solid var(--ed-line); }
.ed-share-url { display: block; margin: 8px 0 12px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 10px; background: #F3F4F6; font-size: 14px; word-break: break-all; }

/* 대시보드 */
.ed-kpis { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; margin-top: 12px; }
.ed-kpi { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--ed-line); border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; }
.ed-kpi b { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.ed-kpi span { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; }
.ed-kpi small { font-size: 12px; color: var(--ed-sub); }
.ed-lead-msg { margin: 8px 0 0; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: #F3F4F6; font-size: 14px; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; }
.ed-chart { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 3px; height: 120px; }
.ed-chart i { flex: 1; min-width: 3px; border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0; background: var(--ed-key); opacity: .85; }
.ed-chart i:last-child { opacity: 1; background: var(--ed-ink); }
.ed-chart-x { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ed-sub); }
.ed-bars { display: grid; gap: 8px; }
.ed-bar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 110px minmax(0, 1fr) 40px; gap: 8px; align-items: center; font-size: 13.5px; }
.ed-bar span { overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.ed-bar i { height: 10px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--ed-key); }
.ed-bar b { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.ed-checks { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 10px; }
.ed-checks li { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-size: 14px; }
.ed-checks .ed-link { flex: 0 0 auto; white-space: nowrap; }
a.ed-btn { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
.ed-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }
.ed-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
.ed-table th, .ed-table td { padding: 9px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ed-line); text-align: right; }
.ed-table thead th { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ed-sub); }
.ed-table thead th small { display: block; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 400; }
.ed-table th[scope="row"], .ed-table thead th:first-child { text-align: left; font-weight: 600; }
.ed-table tbody tr:last-child th, .ed-table tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
.ed-table tr.is-today { background: var(--ed-key-soft); }
.ed-table small { color: var(--ed-sub); font-weight: 400; }
.ed-table small.is-sun { color: #DC2626; }
.ed-table small.is-sat { color: #2563EB; }
.ed-zero { color: #C4C9D0; }
a.ed-btn.is-main { color: #fff; }

@media (min-width: 1024px) {
  .ed-main { grid-template-columns: 460px minmax(0, 1fr); height: calc(100vh - 56px - 55px); }
  .ed-panel { overflow-y: auto; padding: 20px 20px 80px; border-right: 1px solid var(--ed-line); background: var(--ed-bg); }
  .ed-preview { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
  .ed-preview.is-open { position: relative; inset: auto; z-index: auto; }
  .ed-fab, .ed-pv-close { display: none !important; }
  .ed-wiz-grid.has-preview { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 520px) minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .ed-wiz-grid.has-preview .ed-wiz-body { margin: 0; }
  .ed-wiz-pv { position: sticky; top: 70px; height: calc(100vh - 170px); }
  .ed-wiz-nav { justify-content: center; }
  .ed-wiz-nav .ed-btn, .ed-wiz-nav .ed-btn.is-main { flex: 0 1 260px; }
}
.ed-wiz-pv { display: none; }
.ed-wiz-grid.has-preview .ed-wiz-pv { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 480px; border: 1px solid var(--ed-line); border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--ed-bg); }
.ed-wiz-grid.has-preview .ed-wiz-pv .ed-pv-stage { padding: 12px; }
@media (max-width: 1023px) {
  .ed-wiz-grid.has-preview .ed-wiz-pv { order: -1; height: 360px; min-height: 0; }
  .ed-wiz-grid.has-preview .ed-wiz-pv .ed-pv-frame { min-height: 0; transform: scale(.82); transform-origin: top center; height: 420px; }
}
/* 설치 화면 */
.ed-setup-steps{display:flex;gap:6px;list-style:none;margin:6px 0 18px;padding:0;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#9aa0aa}
.ed-setup-steps li{flex:1;padding:8px 6px;border-radius:10px;background:#f3f4f6;text-align:center}
.ed-setup-steps li.is-on{background:#111418;color:#fff}
.ed-setup-steps li.is-done{background:#e8f7ee;color:#157a3e}
.ed-setup-blog{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:14px;border:1.5px solid #e3e5ea;border-radius:14px;background:#fff;font:inherit;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:8px}
.ed-setup-blog small{display:block;color:#6b7280;font-size:13px;margin-top:2px}
.ed-setup-blog.is-on{border-color:#111418;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(17,20,24,.08)}

.ed-seg-wrap{flex-wrap:wrap}

.ed-anim.is-on{border-color:#111418;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(17,20,24,.08)}

.ed-anim-demo{display:flex;gap:4px;height:28px;align-items:flex-end;margin-bottom:4px}
.ed-anim-demo i{flex:1;height:100%;border-radius:6px;background:#dbe4ff}
.ed-anim:hover .ed-anim-demo i,.ed-anim.is-on .ed-anim-demo i{animation:edA 1.6s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) infinite}
.ed-anim-demo i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.08s!important}.ed-anim-demo i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.16s!important}
.ed-anim-demo[data-a="fade"] i{--f:translateY(0)}
.ed-anim-demo[data-a="up"] i{--f:translateY(14px)}
.ed-anim-demo[data-a="zoom"] i{--f:scale(.7)}
.ed-anim-demo[data-a="slide"] i{--f:translateX(-14px)}
.ed-anim-demo[data-a="blur"] i{--f:translateY(4px);--b:blur(4px)}
.ed-anim-demo[data-a="stagger"] i{--f:translateY(14px)}
.ed-anim-demo[data-a="stagger"] i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.25s!important}.ed-anim-demo[data-a="stagger"] i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.5s!important}

@keyframes edA{0%{opacity:0;transform:var(--f);filter:var(--b,none)}45%,100%{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none}}

.ed-draft{font-size:12px;color:#6b7280;white-space:nowrap}

.ed-plan { display: flex; gap: 12px; width: 100%; padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 8px; border: 1.5px solid #e3e5ea; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; text-align: left; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; color: inherit; }
.ed-plan.is-on { border-color: #111418; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #111418 inset; }
.ed-plan[disabled] { opacity: .55; cursor: default; background: #f5f6f8; }
.ed-plan-r { flex: 0 0 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #c7cbd3; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 11px; color: #111418; }
.ed-plan.is-on .ed-plan-r { border-color: #111418; }
.ed-plan-t b { display: block; font-size: 16px; } .ed-plan-t b em { font-style: normal; font-weight: 800; margin-left: 6px; }

.ed-plan-acct { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 12px 14px; margin-bottom: 12px; border-radius: 12px; background: #f5f6f8; font-size: 15px; }
.ed-tier { display: inline-block; margin-left: 4px; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 6px; background: #EEF2FF; color: #3730A3; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; vertical-align: 1px; }
.ed-fx-presets { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; }
.ed-fx-preset { display: block; padding: 12px; border: 1.5px solid #e3e5ea; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; text-align: left; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; color: inherit; }

.ed-fx-preset b { display: block; font-size: 15px; } .ed-fx-preset small { display: block; margin-top: 3px; color: #6b7280; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.45; }
